native_session_budget.basis: Common authoring budget; new independently authored geographies require a fresh zero-model feasibility check before native calibration.

public.name: 金穗丘原
rules: 每项委托两段独立，每段到目标survey采集规定的起始资料；达到本段交付规格才推进，全部完成后回营地submit。
同型站功能等价且固定。全部站型均是候选，具体输入输出由实际process获知，站名不暗示能力。
编目将原始资料转成某种中间规格；核验接受特定规格并产出特定标准。process只反馈本站本份样本的输入、输出和成败，不揭示完整能力列表。
处理失败保留样本。可回本段采集点再次survey丢弃现有样本并取得本段原始起始资料，原尝试和路程仍计入。
未来委托与私有配对不会提前提供。只有Agent自主保存的原生记忆可以跨会话传递。
相同规格代号可在不同资料中重复；同型站对相同资料和输入的结果固定，但对其他资料的输出或核验能力可能不同，不能直接套用。

rationale: An elongated, winding river separates unequal northern town/ridge loops from southern woodland and pasture routes.
Three separated bridge corridors allow real east/west crossing choices; no regular district or repeated local-ring module.
Stations use both through-roads and farm spurs, with varied access degree and uneven regional density.
The camp sits on the northern trade route, outside the geographic centre; southern itineraries must plan a crossing and return.

reference_window.area_method: Spherical longitude/latitude rectangle, mean Earth radius 6371.0088 km.
reference_window.basis: Author-selected regional reference rectangle, not a heritage boundary or measured navigable footprint.

provenance.scope: Historical landscape inspiration only. Roads, drawing coordinates, sites, tasks and processing capabilities are authored; not a historical road reconstruction. Current ecology sources do not establish historical species locations.
provenance.private_boundary: Real names, dates, source URLs and coordinates are excluded from agent observations.

composition_authoring.user_decision: Hard36: 2 standalone + 2 combined uses per basic experience
